FULL-STACK CASE STUDY

Elegance Shawls

A Next.js storefront and FastAPI product API for catalogue browsing, inventory management, and WhatsApp ordering.

Full-stack application
Next.jsFastAPIMongoDBDocker

01 / THE PROBLEM

A connected retail workflow

A product catalogue needs a clear storefront, controlled inventory updates, and a simple route from product discovery to purchase intent.

02 / THE IMPLEMENTATION

Storefront, API, and inventory

The repository contains a Next.js customer storefront and a FastAPI product service backed by MongoDB. Public routes support catalogue browsing and product lookup; authenticated administration routes handle product and stock updates.

03 / THE DELIVERY

Tests and operations

The project includes frontend and backend tests, Playwright coverage, health and readiness endpoints, Docker Compose, and dedicated deployment and operations documentation.

04 / THE SCOPE

WhatsApp-first ordering

Orders are handed off to WhatsApp. The repository documents the implementation and deployment workflow; no sales, customer volume, or live uptime results are claimed here.
